purpose: AIOS AutoResearch v0.2 (issue #409) authority boundary. Fixed policy declaration, not a per-batch record -- see schemas/autoresearch_v02_live_batch_config.schema.json for the per-batch machine-readable contract. 'No implicit conversion is permitted': an available/configured credential, an installed transport, or a passing deterministic check never itself grants any of these authorities.

authority_levels.owner_only: Requires Sergey's explicit, per-instance decision. Never delegated, never inferred from a prior approval of a different instance.
authority_levels.bounded_delegate: May be exercised by Codex/an agent, but only strictly inside a numeric/scope envelope Sergey has already, explicitly, separately authorized (e.g. a frozen budget cap, a frozen manifest). Exceeding the envelope reverts to owner_only for that instance.
authority_levels.not_granted: No path exists yet in v0.2; attempting to exercise this authority is a hard stop, not a request.

implementation_authority.scope: Writing/extending schemas, scripts, tests, and documentation inside the child issues' own Allowed files sections. Never active Project Instructions, routing, or protected surfaces.
implementation_authority.basis: Consistent with v0.1's GOAL_MODE.md Merge Policy and the Codex role boundary already exercised throughout #389-#420.

live_call_authority.scope: Any actual external model/provider/Judge invocation of any kind, on any transport, for any purpose (subject run, Judge run, or smoke test).
live_call_authority.basis: Issue #409's own External-action and budget boundary: 'Before any live batch, freeze and authorize... No authorized transport/budget means blocked; synthetic output is not a substitute.' Not granted by this document -- this document only defines the SHAPE that authorization must take when it is later given.

usage_budget_authority.scope: Setting max_provider_calls / max_input_tokens / max_output_tokens / max_wall_clock_minutes / max_cost_amount / max_cost_currency for any live batch.
usage_budget_authority.basis: Issue #411's own Authority decision: 'The selected transport and numeric batch budget must have explicit authority evidence before #413 performs its live smoke.' No default paid budget is set anywhere in this contract (Forbidden actions).

candidate_acceptance_authority.scope: Treating any keep_candidate result as anything beyond research evidence.
candidate_acceptance_authority.basis: Reuses v0.1's REGRESSION_GATE.md / AES authority separation unchanged: 'keep_candidate remains owner_review_pending and cannot mutate active Project Instructions/routing.'

active_configuration_authority.scope: Any edit to a live ChatGPT Project's actual configuration, Project Instructions, or Knowledge files.
active_configuration_authority.basis: Issue #409 Safety boundaries: 'Active ChatGPT Project settings and main are not experiment targets.' No v0.2 child issue requests this authority; it stays not_granted for the life of this contract version.

merge_authority.basis: Absolute repository rule, independent of AutoResearch: agents must never merge PRs (GOAL_MODE.md Merge Policy, reinforced by the platform's own permission classifier). Not a decision this contract could grant even if it wanted to.

production_authority.scope: Any production deployment or promotion claim.
production_authority.basis: Same as merge_authority; also explicitly out of scope for AutoResearch entirely per issue #388's and #409's own Forbidden actions.

no_implicit_conversion_examples: An installed/connected transport (e.g. Playwright MCP showing 'Connected') does NOT itself grant live_call_authority.
A frozen context_manifest_hash does NOT itself grant usage_budget_authority.
usage_budget_authority being granted for one numeric envelope does NOT extend to a larger or different envelope without a new, separate owner decision.
implementation_authority to write the live adapter code does NOT include live_call_authority to actually run it against a real target.
